about: Plain TypeScript: enums, namespaces, classes, using, type syntax. Per-file (transpileModule) output.

async-super-index.ts.why: tsc bug, not copied: at ES2017 (async methods native) tsc rewrites super in the native async methods to an undeclared _super/_superIndex when the file also has async generators (a ReferenceError at run time); ternts keeps super

static-accessor-unnamed.ts.why: guards against the old refusal (a crash fails it anyway): at ES2022 tsc reads the storage through a temp it never assigns (_a.#a_accessor_storage, a TypeError at run time), where ternts uses the variable the class is assigned to; below that, ternts names the default class's storage _b_accessor_storage (tsc: _default_1_b_accessor_storage) and writes exports.X after the class instead of folding it

enum-nonfinite.ts.why: guards against crashes (a crash fails it anyway): tsc folds members through non-finite values (2 ** 1e300 is Infinity, 5 % (1/0) is 5) where ternts leaves an expression that reaches Infinity, NaN or a division by zero as written
